## Checklist

- [ ] One purpose: this PR does one thing, and `Closes #` above names its issue.
- [ ] If behavior changed, the relevant `SPEC.md` (and its changelog) is updated in this PR.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Screenshots are included for any change you can see in the app.
- [ ] Works with the keyboard alone; nothing is shown by color alone.
- [ ] Example content is illustrative: no statistics, market shares or named-company claims.
- [ ] `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `replit.md`, the skills and `.github/` are unchanged (unless that's the purpose of this PR).
